project_description: Elegant frontend-only wedding seating planner: room layout with tables and fixtures, drag-and-drop guest seating, CSV import, all persisted in the browser (localStorage). No backend, no database, no login.
design_context: Editorial fine-stationery feel carried by the planner palette: rose/cream/gold/warm-gray, Playfair Display headings + Inter body. Calm, low-density, ornamental dividers, pill controls, warm shadows. Never generic SaaS, never the old blush/sage hues.
